"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to a .pptx file."""
import glob
import os
import re
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

P_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main"
A_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"
R_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
REL_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"
CT_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"
SLIDE_REL = R_NS + "/slide"
SLIDE_CT = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"
MESSAGE = "Thank you for your attention"

ET.register_namespace("p", P_NS)
ET.register_namespace("a", A_NS)
ET.register_namespace("r", R_NS)


def q(ns, tag):
    return "{%s}%s" % (ns, tag)


def find_pptx(arg):
    if arg and os.path.isfile(arg):
        return arg
    hits = sorted(glob.glob("*.pptx") + glob.glob(os.path.join("..", "*.pptx")))
    if not hits:
        raise SystemExit("No .pptx file found (looked for %r)" % (arg or "Q4_financial_report.pptx"))
    for h in hits:
        if os.path.basename(h) == "Q4_financial_report.pptx":
            return h
    return hits[0]


def add_slide_pptx(path):
    from pptx import Presentation
    from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
    from pptx.util import Emu, Pt

    prs = Presentation(path)
    layout = prs.slides[-1].slide_layout
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(layout)
    for ph in list(slide.placeholders):
        ph._element.getparent().remove(ph._element)
    w, h = prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Emu(int(w * 0.1)), Emu(int(h * 0.42)), Emu(int(w * 0.8)), Emu(int(h * 0.16)))
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = MESSAGE
    run.font.size = Pt(40)
    run.font.bold = True
    prs.save(path)

    prs2 = Presentation(path)
    last = prs2.slides[-1]
    if not any(MESSAGE in sh.text_frame.text for sh in last.shapes if sh.has_text_frame):
        raise SystemExit("Verification failed: message not found on the final slide")
    print("OK: python-pptx added final slide; total slides = %d" % len(prs2.slides))

    cNvPr.set("name", "")
    ET.SubElement(nvGrp, q(P_NS, "cNvGrpSpPr"))
    ET.SubElement(nvGrp, q(P_NS, "nvPr"))

    nvSpPr = ET.SubElement(sp, q(P_NS, "nvSpPr"))

    cNvSpPr.set("txBox", "1")

    xfrm = ET.SubElement(spPr, q(A_NS, "xfrm"))

    ext.set("cx", str(width))

    bodyPr.set("anchor", "ctr")

    pPr.set("algn", "ctr")

    rPr.set("lang", "en-US")
    rPr.set("sz", "3200")
    rPr.set("b", "1")

    t.text = MESSAGE

    ET.SubElement(clrMapOvr, q(A_NS, "masterClrMapping"))
    return sld

    m = re.search(r"([A-Za-z_][\w.-]*):id=\"(rId\d+)\"", sld_ids[-1])
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit("Could not find last slide id in presentation.xml")
    last_rid = m.group(2)

    rels_xml = data[rels_path].decode("utf-8")
    rels_root = ET.fromstring(rels_xml)
    targets = {}
    for rel in rels_root:
        if rel.get("Type") == SLIDE_REL:
            targets[rel.get("Id")] = rel.get("Target")
    if last_rid not in targets:
        raise SystemExit("Last slide relationship not found in presentation.xml.rels")
    last_target = targets[last_rid]
    nums = [int(mm.group(1)) for t in targets.values() for mm in [re.search(r"slide(\d+)\.xml$", t)] if mm]
    new_num = max(nums) + 1
    new_target = "slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num
    new_name = "ppt/" + new_target

    rid_nums = [int(mm.group(1)) for mm in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels_xml)]
    new_rid = "rId%d" % (max(rid_nums) + 1) if rid_nums else "rId1"

    sldSz = ET.fromstring(pres_xml).find(q(P_NS, "sldSz"))
    cx, cy = (int(sldSz.get("cx")), int(sldSz.get("cy"))) if sldSz is not None else (12192000, 6858000)

    data[new_name] = b'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\r\n' + ET.tostring(
        build_slide(cx, cy), encoding="utf-8"
    )

    last_rel = "ppt/slides/_rels/" + os.path.basename(last_target) + ".rels"
    new_rel_name = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num
    if last_rel in data:
        data[new_rel_name] = data[last_rel]

    new_id = max(int(mm.group(1)) for mm in re.findall(r"\sid=\"(\d+)\"", pres_xml)) + 1
    rprefix = m.group(1)
    data[pres_path] = pres_xml.replace(
        "</p:sldIdLst>",
        '<p:sldId id="%d" %s:id="%s"/></p:sldIdLst>' % (new_id, rprefix, new_rid),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    data[rels_path] = rels_xml.replace(
        "</Relationships>",
        '<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s" Target="%s"/></Relationships>' % (new_rid, SLIDE_REL, new_target),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    data[ct_path] = data[ct_path].decode("utf-8").replace(
        "</Types>",
        '<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/></Types>' % (new_name, SLIDE_CT),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for name in names:
            zout.writestr(name, data[name])
        for name in data:
            if name not in names:
                zout.writestr(name, data[name])
    os.replace(tmp, path)

    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        v = ET.fromstring(z.read(pres_path))
        count = len(v.find(q(P_NS, "sldIdLst")).findall(q(P_NS, "sldId")))
        assert count == n_original + 1, "slide count mismatch"
        assert ET.fromstring(z.read(new_name)).find(".//" + q(A_NS, "t")).text == MESSAGE
        assert ("/" + new_name).encode("utf-8") in z.read(ct_path)
    print("OK: added final slide %s; total slides = %d" % (new_target, count))


def main():
    path = find_pptx(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "")
    try:

    except ImportError:

    else:
        add_slide_pptx(path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

ET.register_namespace("a", A_NS)
ET.register_namespace("r", R_NS)


def q(ns, tag):
    return "{%s}%s" % (ns, tag)


def find_pptx(arg):
    if arg and os.path.isfile(arg):
        return arg
    hits = sorted(glob.glob("*.pptx") + glob.glob(os.path.join("..", "*.pptx")))

def patch_app_xml(data):
    if "docProps/app.xml" not in data:
        return

    m = re.search(r"<Slides>(\d+)</Slides>", xml)

        data["docProps/app.xml"] = xml.replace(

        ).encode("utf-8")

    cNvPr.set("name", "")
    ET.SubElement(nvGrp, q(P_NS, "cNvGrpSpPr"))
    ET.SubElement(nvGrp, q(P_NS, "nvPr"))

    grp = ET.SubElement(spTree, q(P_NS, "grpSpPr"))

    rels_path = "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"
    ct_path = "[Content_Types].xml"
    for req in (pres_path, rels_path, ct_path):
        if req not in data:
            raise SystemExit("%s missing from package" % req)

    if "</p:sldIdLst>" not in pres_xml:
        raise SystemExit("Unexpected presentation.xml structure (no sldIdLst close tag)")

    n_original = len(sld_ids)
    if not sld_ids:
        raise SystemExit("Presentation has no slides")
    m = re.search(r"([A-Za-z_][\w.-]*):id=\"(rId\d+)\"", sld_ids[-1])
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit("Could not find last slide id in presentation.xml")
    last_rid = m.group(2)

    rels_xml = data[rels_path].decode("utf-8")
    rels_root = ET.fromstring(rels_xml)
    targets = {}
    for rel in rels_root:
        if rel.get("Type") == SLIDE_REL:
            targets[rel.get("Id")] = rel.get("Target")
    if last_rid not in targets:
        raise SystemExit("Last slide relationship not found in presentation.xml.rels")
    last_target = targets[last_rid]
    nums = [int(mm.group(1)) for t in targets.values() for mm in [re.search(r"slide(\d+)\.xml$", t)] if mm]
    new_num = max(nums) + 1
    new_target = "slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num
    new_name = "ppt/" + new_target

    rid_nums = [int(mm.group(1)) for mm in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels_xml)]
    new_rid = "rId%d" % (max(rid_nums) + 1) if rid_nums else "rId1"

    sldSz = ET.fromstring(pres_xml).find(q(P_NS, "sldSz"))
    cx, cy = (int(sldSz.get("cx")), int(sldSz.get("cy"))) if sldSz is not None else (12192000, 6858000)

    data[new_name] = b'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\r\n' + ET.tostring(
        build_slide(cx, cy), encoding="utf-8"
    )

    last_rel = "ppt/slides/_rels/" + os.path.basename(last_target) + ".rels"
    new_rel_name = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num
    if last_rel in data:
        data[new_rel_name] = data[last_rel]

    new_id = max(int(mm.group(1)) for mm in re.findall(r"\sid=\"(\d+)\"", pres_xml)) + 1
    rprefix = m.group(1)
    data[pres_path] = pres_xml.replace(
        "</p:sldIdLst>",
        '<p:sldId id="%d" %s:id="%s"/></p:sldIdLst>' % (new_id, rprefix, new_rid),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    data[rels_path] = rels_xml.replace(
        "</Relationships>",
        '<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s" Target="%s"/></Relationships>' % (new_rid, SLIDE_REL, new_target),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    data[ct_path] = data[ct_path].decode("utf-8").replace(
        "</Types>",
        '<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/></Types>' % (new_name, SLIDE_CT),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    patch_app_xml(data)

    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for name in names:
            zout.writestr(name, data[name])
        for name in data:
            if name not in names:
                zout.writestr(name, data[name])
    os.replace(tmp, path)

    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        v = ET.fromstring(z.read(pres_path))
        count = len(v.find(q(P_NS, "sldIdLst")).findall(q(P_NS, "sldId")))
        assert count == n_original + 1, "slide count mismatch"
        assert ET.fromstring(z.read(new_name)).find(".//" + q(A_NS, "t")).text == MESSAGE
        assert ("/" + new_name).encode("utf-8") in z.read(ct_path)
    print("OK: added final slide %s; total slides = %d" % (new_target, count))


def main():
    path = find_pptx(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "")
    try:
        import pptx  # noqa: F401
    except ImportError:
        add_slide_ooxml(path)
    else:
        add_slide_pptx(path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
